thread:
alice: FYI bringing up apac-south2 GPU pool now. Starting bootstrap 00:00 UTC.
ben: Nice. What's the plan for initial smoke tests?
alice: run node-register -> cuda-check -> nvidia-smi -> pod-launch smoke. also network iPerf between nodes and control plane.
carol: started node registration. hitting kubelet 'Node NotReady' on 3/12 nodes.
alice: logs?
carol: ```
Mar 04 00:12:03 host kubelet[1234]: E0324 00:12:03.123456 kubelet_server.go:434] node "gk1-az1-gpu-07" not ready: failed to start network plugin: failed to set up CNI: operation timed out
``` 
raj: could be CNI MTU. APAC provider has default 1400, we set 900 for gpu tunneled overlay. mtu mismatch causes fragmentation and timeouts.
maria: i ran tcpdump on control plane -> saw ICMP fragmentation-needed from node to cp.
ben: ok reduce overlay MTU to 1200 and restart CNI on affected nodes.
carol: applying config now: `kubectl -n kube-system patch daemonset calico-node -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"calico-node","env":[{"name":"FELIX_IPINIPMTU","value":"1200"}]}]}}}}'`
deploy-bot: deploy started for daemonset calico-node (uid: ds-7890)
carol: restarted calico pods, nodes moved to Ready for 9/12. 3 still flaky.
alice: which 3? log snippets?
carol: two have old kernel missing NFS module causing kubelet crashloops on volume mounts; one has driver mismatch (nvidia driver 525 vs expected 530)
raj: schedule kernel upgrade and driver re-provisioning. we have automation script: `/opt/infra/bin/gpu-bootstrap --driver-version 530 --reboot`.
maria: running script for the two kernels now, will reboot them in maintenance window.
ben: while rebooting, we should mark cluster in 'degraded' readiness state and pause the rollout of any customer-facing traffic. set traffic-routes to fallthrough to sfo-gpu-pool.
oncall-jp: can confirm loadbalancer failover is ready. set rw-route apac-south2 -> off.

- node count >=12
- all nodes Ready
- nvidia-smi shows GPUs visible
- sample gpu job completes within 2m
- control-plane latency <50ms for metadata API
- e2e perf: 1-token latency within expected SLO
carol: ran smoke job, sample job got this error: `cuda out of memory` on p3-large. looks like allocation limit; double-checked pod resource requests.
raj: that's expected on small instance types, we should pin gpu-heavy inference pods to p4-like shapes. For validation, spin test pod with resources: `limits.nvidia.com/gpu: 1` and `requests.memory: 64Gi`.
maria: test pod passed on 10/12 nodes. overall token-per-second benchmark within 8% of expected. cost estimate for 12-node pool at reserved pricing: $2.2/hr/node -> monthly ~ $47k.

alice: enable burst capacity but gated: max 3 nodes burst, auto-scale cooldown 10m. add to handoff checklist.
